originality.rationale: The known Wigner-Pell zero does not imply the existence or sharp minimality of a positive fourteen-colatitude tight sampling rule. Direct examination of the spin sampling paper and Pell-zero survey, plus actual published-finding corpus claim searches, found no stronger theorem subsuming the exact quadrature certificate. General historical cubature coverage remains a risk.
residual_risks: Equivalent specialized degree-exceptional positive quadrature could appear under a different term in early cubature literature; Xu 1998 full text not inspected.
The Pell zero is old; novelty is claimed only for its sharp positive sampling consequence.
No independent external audit has been performed.
